notes.title: Version 0.4.19 Patch Notes
notes.notes:
Attention Divers,

We've deployed a hotfix addressing a number of bugs.

[b]General[/b]
[list]
[*] Increased Depth Charge spawning chance
[/list]
[b]Bug Fixes[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed AI navigation issue in room Refinery_OilStorage(3x4)
[*] Fixed AI navigation issue in room Laboratory_Offices_02(3x4)
[*] Improved outpost hallway generation. Impossible to reach sections should be much less common
[*] Fixed issue with Factory outposts spawning with impossible to reach areas
[*] Fixed issue with Residential outposts and Soviet Residential outposts spawning with impossible to reach areas
Issue with Seismic Rift biome background colour fixed
[*] Kraken Tentacle leak no longer hovers above floor
[*] Gramophone room can no longer generate leaks}
[/list]
[hr][/hr]

Thanks for supporting Darkwater on its Early Access journey!

Are you experiencing bugs? Please let us know in our [url=https://forms.gle/L2848n9wFVqJyAvs5]bug report form here.[/url]

- Targon Studios

notes.title: Invasion Update Available Now!
notes.notes: [previewyoutube="u0ZOyShmQz4;full"][/previewyoutube][p][/p][p][b]Darkwater's first major update - INVASION - is available now![/b] [/p][p]This update focuses on improving many aspects of the gameplay loop, including new enemies, locations, system mechanics, and more. [/p][p][/p][p]Some highlights include:[/p][list][*][p][b]Stealth system[/b] - players can now crouch, and a visual indicator has been added that denotes how sneaky you are being. Enemy AI has also been adjusted to react to sound, allowing you to avoid engagements.[/p][/*][*][p][b]New enemies[/b] - four new aquatic creatures will roam the vacant outposts, some more dangerous than others. [/p][/*][*][p][b]New Leviathan[/b] - The Kraken. This monolithic creature will capture your submarine with its tentacles that are capable of piercing the hull. Avoid at all costs.[/p][/*][*][p][b]New Submarine Equipment[/b] - Arm your sub with Depth Charges and Explosive Harpoons, craft supplies equipment from the medical bay crafting bench, and install the new Command Room ship module  - now available from the shop.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Harpoon Gun[/b] - A new heavy duty rifle that can be found inside outposts that propels harpoons at terminal velocity.[/p][/*][*][p][b]New District[/b] to explore - Frontier[/p][/*][*][p][b]Biomes[/b] - Four new biomes to explore while navigating districts. This combined with 9 new variations of pirate submarines have been detected searching the depths adds a lot more variety (and danger) to naval combat.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]And that is just scratching the surface. Check out the full patch notes below.[/p][p][/p][h2]Patch Notes Version 0.4.18 - INVASION[/h2][h3]General[/h3][list][*][p]Sneaking mechanic implemented. Players can now crouch and a a visual indicator is now visible on the HUD that shows how much attention you are drawing to yourself, making it easier to avoid encounters.[/p][/*][*][p]Game now refreshes upon entering a new district to improve overall game and network stability.[/p][/*][*][p]Can no longer consume items at full health. No more accidents![/p][/*][*][p]Clients now see a locked screen in the lobby for the host settings.[/p][/*][*][p]New emails added to the terminals.[/p][/*][*][p]Hacking minigame has been made slightly more difficult on Easy. Path length increased: 4 -> 5[/p][/*][*][p]Stampers glow effect slightly reduced.[/p][/*][*][p]New items can now be displayed on the tool board: Wrench, Squeaky Hammer, Harpoon Gun.[/p][/*][*][p]Mice now scream upon falling into the abyss.[/p][/*][*][p]Mice no longer run out of stamina.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3]Submarine Systems[/h3][list][*][p]New submarine system: Command Room.[/p][/*][*][p]New crew damaging weapons (Explosive Harpoons, Depth Charges) now deal bonus damage against leviathans (+50%).[/p][/*][*][p]Medium Arsenal Double Shotgun count reduced: 2 -> 1[/p][/*][*][p]Medium Arsenal Shotgun Ammo count reduced: 16 -> 8[/p][/*][*][p]Player and enemy diver locations and health now display on combat screen.[/p][/*][*][p]9 new enemy submarines implemented.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3]Submarine Weapons[/h3][list][*][p]New weapon: Depth Charge Mk.1, Depth Charge Mk.2, Explosive Harpoon Mk.1, Explosive Harpoon Mk.2.[/p][/*][*][p]Certain weapons can now deal crew damage. Watch that friendly fire![/p][/*][*][p]New leviathan weapon: Ink Blob, Tentacle, Barnacle[/p][/*][*][p]Submarine weapons that deal no water or system damage no longer disable lights in the targeted room. [/p][/*][*][p]New explosion effect for weapons that deal crew damage[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3]Enemies[/h3][list][*][p]New alien enemy: Jumbo Crab[/p][/*][*][p]New alien enemy: Tentacle[/p][/*][*][p]New alien enemy: Stalker (Angler variant) [/p][/*][*][p]New alien enemy: Sanctum Crab (Yeti Crab variant) [/p][/*][*][p]Angler health increased: 150 -> 170[/p][/*][*][p]Enemy hearing mechanic implemented - Certain enemies will now react to sounds.[/p][/*][*][p]Yeti Crab renamed to Burrow Crab[/p][/*][*][p]Burrow Crab health reduced: 60 -> 35[/p][/*][*][p]Burrow Crab damage reduced: 10 -> 8[/p][/*][*][p]Burrow Crab death animation updated[/p][/*][*][p]Enemy submarine divers AI updated[/p][/*][*][p]Alien spawning improved. Difficult enemies won't appear early, and will appear more frequently the further players progress[/p][/*][*][p]Can no longer strike dead enemies[/p][/*][*][p]Enemy divers now drop items[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3]Leviathans[/h3][list][*][p]New leviathan added: Kraken[/p][/*][*][p]New Kraken combat sound track added[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3]Biomes[/h3][list][*][p]Biomes notes.title: Community Update #2 is now live
notes.notes: [p]Hello Divers,[/p][p][/p][p]Today we are shipping part 2 of the community updates addressing feedback submitted by the playerbase. This update will serve as the foundation for future context expansions - the first of which will be releasing this summer. Refer to the roadmap on the store page for more details![/p][p][/p][p][b][u]Patch Notes Version 0.3.16[/u][/b][/p][list][*][p]Sticker cabinet introduced to lobby[/p][/*][*][p]Squeaky Hammer implemented[/p][/*][*][p]Blood effects introduced[/p][/*][*][p]Apothecary table added to Medbay[/p][/*][*][p]Torpedo/Mine bay weapon hatch model updated[/p][/*][*][p]Fade added to main menu when booting the game up[/p][/*][/list][p] [b][u]Outpost[/u][/b] [/p][list][*][p]New outpost quest: Locked Storage[/p][/*][*][p]New outpost rooms: LockedRoom_00(3x3), LockedRoom_01(3x3), and CommunicationsRoom_00(3x3)[/p][/*][*][p]New mansion rooms: Piano Dining Room (4x4), Grand Piano (3x4)[/p][/*][*][p]New factory rooms: Elevator Shaft (3x3), Elevator Shaft (3x5)[/p][/*][*][p]New residential rooms: Bunk Hall (2x5)[/p][/*][*][p]New storage rooms: Elevator Storage (5x5)[/p][/*][*][p]Lots of new room blocks[/p][/*][*][p]Church rooms removed from Soviet Residential outposts[/p][/*][/list][p] [b][u]Bug Fixes[/u][/b] [/p][list][*][p]Fixed issue with node map not generating sometimes when entering abandoned districts,[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed issue where items could be picked up through certain colliders,[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed issue with Angler jumping in place,[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed AI navigation issues with engine rooms,[/p][/*][*][p]Piloting minigame now uses movement key bindings,[/p][/*][*][p]Item quantities no longer display in inventory after dying,[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed issue with district selection not syncing,[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed wrench animation issue,[/p][/*][*][p]Some players experiencing everything "Missing" in main menu should be fixed,[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed display issue in arcade games when reaching a score over 1000,[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed issue with not being able to restart after dying in tutorial[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]As an added bonus, Darkwater will be 20% off for the remainder of the Steam Summer Sale until July 10 - notes.title: Community Update #1 is now live
notes.notes: [p]Hello Divers,[/p][p][/p][p]Today we are shipping part 1 of a new update aimed at addressing some commonly requested features and quality-of-life improvements. Additionally, there has been several improvements to outpost generation logic.[/p][p][/p][p][u][b]Patch Notes Version 0.3.10[/b][/u][/p][list][*][p]New language files implemented[/p][/*][*][p]Intro event added to first node[/p][/*][*][p]First district size reduced to 16 nodes[/p][/*][*][p]New district added: ResidentialCalm (Always starts as the first district, spawns with more outposts, stores, and less hostile encounters)[/p][/*][*][p]New batch of easy enemy submarines added that only spawn on the first district when on easy mode[/p][/*][*][p]Piloting sonar map size slightly decreased[/p][/*][/list][p] [u][b]Outposts[/b][/u] [/p][list][*][p]All outpost types have been given a unique entrance room. Welcome![/p][/*][*][p]All outpost entrance rooms have been given a neon exit sign, in case you want to leave.[/p][/*][*][p]Room culling implemented[/p][/*][*][p]Outpost generation should no longer generate dead-end hallways[/p][/*][*][p]Outpost sizes slightly decreased for 4 player runs[/p][/*][/list][p] [u][b]Settings[/b][/u] [/p][list][*][p]Rebindable keys added[/p][/*][*][p]Inverted Y toggle added[/p][/*][*][p]FOV slider moved to gameplay tab[/p][/*][*][p]V-Sync toggle added[/p][/*][*][p]Performance Fog toggle added[/p][/*][*][p]FPS cap slider added[/p][/*][*][p]Headbob toggle added. No more motion sickness![/p][/*][*][p]Adrenaline Zoom toggle added[/p][/*][/list][p] [u][b]Bug Fixes[/b][/u] [/p][list][*][p]Several audio issues fixed[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed floating assets in many laboratory rooms. Oops.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed navigation/collider issue in Catwalk_Corridor(3x5)[/p][/*][*][p]Several pathfinding/collider issues fixed with many rooms[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed issue with tutorial piloting sonar map not generating correctly[/p][/*][*][p]Missing localization in keybindings setting fixed[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed issue with communication screen not returning player to piloting screen after completing dialogue[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed issue with broken mansion room block[/p][/*][*][p]Several pathfinding/collider issues fixed with many rooms[/p][/*][/list][p] [u][b]QA Fixes[/b][/u] [/p][list][*][p]Fixed missing translations in controls menu[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed overlapping text in the hack button[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed untranslated warning titles in store[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]That's it for now. We will be releasing part 2 of this update in the coming weeks to prepare for our first major content expansion releasing later this summer, which will add new weapons, enemies, locations, and more. Until then, we'll see you below the surface![/p][p][/p][p]- Targon Studios[/p]

notes.title: Version 0.2.43 Patch Notes
notes.notes:
Attention Divers,

We've deployed an update addressing reported issues and applied adjustments based on player feedback.

[b]General[/b]
[list]
[*] New texture added to arcade cabinet: Breaker
[*] Another mysterious effect added to cross item
[*] Player melee range slightly increased
[/list]
[b]Enemies[/b]
[list]
[*] Enemy divers now have a chance of fleeing and hiding from players when on low health,
[*] Enemy divers now have a chance of fleeing and hiding from players when spotting them,
[*] Infected now unpredictably flee from players,
[*] Enemies targeting improved,
[*] Enemy diver melee swing speed reduced by 15%,
[*] Enemy infected melee swing speed reduced by 15%,
[*] Infected no longer block,
[*] Crab hitbox increased,
[*] Crab damage slightly increased: 9->10,
[*] Clam swarm hitbox increased,
[*] Clams now only deal damage while swarming
[/list]
[b]Bug Fixes[/b]
[list]
[*] Potentially fixed issue with no nodes spawning on piloting map,
[*] Fixed issue with clipping outside of enemy submarines after boarding them using the pneumatic launcher,
[*] Fixed issue with joining matches when enabling "Solo Offline" and then trying to join a lobby,
[*] Reload required no longer displays on submarines without a weapon system
[*] Fixed issue where electric lighting didn't count towards player visibility,
[*] Fixed extreme outpost shaking when a bomb detonates,
[*] Fixed bug where NULL rooms could be picked up from player submarines in the store
[/list]
[b]Localization[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed incorrect localization on manned torpedo
[/list]
[hr][/hr]
We will continue monitoring any issues, addressing any feedback from the community, and deploy hotfixes.

Thanks for supporting us on our Early Access journey!

Are you experiencing bugs? Please let us know in our [url=https://forms.gle/L2848n9wFVqJyAvs5]bug report form here.[/url]

- Targon Studios

notes.title: Version 0.2.41 Patch Notes
notes.notes:
Attention Divers,

We've deployed a hotfix addressing reported issues and applied adjustments based on player feedback.

[b]General[/b]
[list]
[*] Mice no longer get teleported to a separate room, and now instead spawn on the player corpse allowing them to explore the submarine/outposts
[*] Factories no longer spawn in the Mining District
[*] Electric light flickering speed reduced by 40%
[*] Can no longer close doors on enemy submarines
[/list]
[b]Items[/b]
[list]
[*] Cross now has mysterious effects
[/list]
[b]Bug Fixes[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed issue with Automatic Pump
[*] Annoying blocking animation issue fixed, blocking should be more consistent
[*] Hot-join desync fixes
[*] Player corpses no longer hold items
[*] Fixed issue where mine weapons would break, and could never be deployed in combat
[*] Gramophone now syncs music over the network
[*] Tutorial text fixed for ultra-wide monitors
[*] Players who are abandoned in outposts/shops now properly lose their items
[*] Players can no longer jump down the airlock when there's no store or outpost connected
[*] Item locker duplication exploit fixed
[*] Fixed issue where FOV wasn't properly being set when starting a run
[*] Players performing actions should no longer take damage (ex. riding in a manned torpedo)
[*] Fixed issue with "Against All Odds" Achievement
[*] Fixed issue with displaying lobbies when booting up the game in a region that wasn't US West
[*] Various language fixes for missing strings, corrections, and line breaks
[/list][hr][/hr]
We will continue monitoring any issues, addressing any feedback from the community, and deploy hotfixes.

Thanks for supporting us on our Early Access journey!

Are you experiencing bugs? Please let us know in our [url=https://forms.gle/L2848n9wFVqJyAvs5]bug report form here.[/url]

- Targon Studios

notes.title: Darkwater Demo Cumulative Patch Notes 0.1.9
notes.notes:
Divers,

A number of changes have been made based on player feedback since the last closed playtest. Highlights include the new District Anarchy System, sweeping difficulty adjustments, and a new district that includes several new outposts to explore.

[h2]Features[/h2]
[h3]New District Anarchy System[/h3]
A new system has been added that slowly plunges districts into chaos, making them very dangerous, and encouraging players to exit districts. This is to address players spending large amounts of time farming resources.
[list]
[*] A new visual indicator will be displayed in the upper right corner of the screen denoting the current anarchy level
[*] Anarchy increases more quickly on harder difficulties
[*] 15 anarchy events added
[/list]
[h3]General[/h3]
[list]
[*] K-100 submarine has been unlocked for players to use in the Demo
[*] New Soviet District with unique outposts added; Soviet Residential, Soviet Penal, Soviet Hospital
[*] Outposts optimized, should see improved framerate
[*] New music track added: Soviet District,
[*] Districts grow more difficult as players progress 
[*] Difficulty levels have been heavily adjusted
[*] Main menu theme updated
[*] Enemy ships on higher difficulties are now harder to sink
[*] Gramophone room has been added as a rare item spawn in drydock
[*] Record item (Anthem for Mice) has been added as a rare item spawn
[*] Updated main menu: New intro message, new bug report URL
[*] Inventory full notification now displays when players try and pick up an item
[/list]
[h3]Map[/h3]
[list]
[*] District system implemented
[*] Residential district implemented
[*] Soviet district implemented
[*] Sonar map generation size decreased by about 80% (With the introduction of districts, sonar map size has been restored to its original size)
[*] Lots of new node events added, specifically for Soviet Controlled District
[*] Nodes now always contain an event
[*] Sonar map generation overhaul, maps will now be generated in a more linear way
[*] Transit Station no longer spawns near the starting node
[*] Visited Stores and Outposts are renamed to "Visited" after docking for clarity
[/list]
[h3]Shop[/h3]
[list]
[*] Players can no longer interact with shop when players are inside submarine
[*] Players can no longer enter submarine while a player is interacting with the shop
[*] Terminal now displays an error when there is more than 1 of the same weapon system (for example, 2 torpedo bays)
[*] Many system room displays updated
[*] Outdated room displays in shop updated
[/list]
[h3]Systems[/h3]
[list]
[*] Pneumatic Launcher has been added
[*] Workshop submarine system has been added
[*] Small storage room implemented
[/list]
[h3]Outposts[/h3]
[list]
[*] Outpost lamps now have a chance of being broken
[*] Lanterns can now be extinguished
[*] Outposts have a chance to spawn with flickering lights, can be repaired
[*] Enemies can no longer spawn in outpost starting room
[*] Broadcasting SOS when connected to an outpost now destroys the outpost and shuts the airlock
[/list]
[h3]Bug Fixes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Addressed a large number of bugs identified in the playtest
[*] Items no longer vanish when dropped in store
[*] Crashes as a result of attempting to load into a match should be drastically reduced
[*] Doors no longer shove players out of bounds
[*] Item duplication fixed
[*] Fixed leaks appearing in spots that can’t be reached
[*] Fixed various visual mismatches between host and guest players
[/list]
Experiencing any issues in the demo? Let us know at https://forms.gle/Gt1a6LFnLo5Ra17g8 

Enjoy the demo and share your feedback at https://forms.gle/qHXhsYjWtVKRMagE9 and chat with us on Discord at https://discord.gg/ZMC8uXcx4g

A huge thanks to players who offered feedback during the playtest! 

-Darkwater Team
